method.method_draft: First describe the figure: the excess-electron concentration in the base forms a triangular distribution over the neutral base width \(W_B=0.5\,\mu\text{m}\), with peak \(n_E=10^{14}\,\text{cm}^{-3}\) at the emitter side and zero at the collector side. Compute the total stored excess electron charge in the base from the triangular area under the concentration profile, \(Q_n=qA(n_EW_B/2)\). method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个 npn BJT 结构，左侧为 n 型发射区，中间为 p 型基区，右侧为 n 型集电区。基区内的虚线标注为“Excess electron profile”，表示注入的过剩电子浓度沿基区线性下降：在发射结一侧约为 10^14 cm^-3，在集电结一侧降为 0。图中标出的中性基区宽度为 W_B = 0.5 μm。

推理：已知 A = 0.001 cm^2，μ_n = 800 cm^2/(V·s)，V_T = 26 mV = 0.026 V，q = 1.6×10^-19 C。电子扩散系数为 D_n = μ_n V_T = 800 × 0.026 = 20.8 cm^2/s。基区宽度 W_B = 0.5 μm = 5×10^-5 cm。

按照线性三角形浓度分布，基区存储的过剩电子电荷为 Q_n = q A (n_E W_B/2)。代入 n_E = 10^14 cm^-3：Q_n = 1.6×10^-19 × 0.001 × (10^14 × 5×10^-5 / 2) = 4.0×10^-13 C。

基区渡越时间 τ_B = W_B^2/(2D_n) = (5×10^-5)^2/(2×20.8) = 6.01×10^-11 s。

因此集电极电流 I_C = Q_n/τ_B = (4.0×10^-13)/(6.01×10^-11) = 6.656×10^-3 A = 6.656 mA，约为 6.65 mA。
